name: Dreadmist Den
summary: Burning Blade cultists keep their rites beneath Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. Red haze fills the cavern they use as a shrine to demons.

sections.title: A Den of Wicked Shadows
sections.body: Dreadmist Den opens among the jagged slopes of Dreadmist Peak. Burning Blade cultists gather in its dark sanctuary, where thick crimson vapor dims the stone tunnels to red twilight. Beyond the Horde's watch on the plains below, the cult performs demonic rites and guards its blasphemous relics. It plots to spread corruption across Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Demon Seed
sections.body: Deep in Dreadmist Den, the Demon Seed rests above the Altar of Fire. The Burning Blade prizes the artifact for its fel power, and it is connected to the Burning Legion. Ak'Zeloth prepares a power stone to disrupt that connection. Horde scouts and aspiring warlocks who follow the cult's activity face danger in the cavern as they seek to learn how far demonic influence reaches in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Dreadmist Den lies beneath Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. Burning Blade cultists use its caves as an enclave and a place for their rites.

faq.q: What causes the red mist inside the den?
faq.answer: Red haze shrouds Dreadmist Den and the peak above it. Burning Blade cultists perform demonic rites there, though the haze's exact cause is unknown.

faq.q: What is the Demon Seed found inside?
faq.answer: The Demon Seed is a dark artifact kept deep within Dreadmist Den. The Burning Blade prizes it as a powerful focus for fel magic.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this cave?
faq.answer: The Horde fears the Burning Blade's demon worship and its efforts to undermine the Horde across Kalimdor. A stronghold near Crossroads and Orgrimmar threatens the Barrens' security.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may be drawn to the demonic relics and volatile fel energies within Dreadmist Den, and to the Burning Blade's dark secrets.

As a member of the Horde, you face danger from the Burning Blade den overlooking the Barrens. Its presence threatens nearby trade routes and settlements, calling for swift action from Horde defenders.
